title: 고1 레벨테스트 A형
description: 초급~중급: 고1 기본 어휘·숙어, 자동사·관계대명사·동명사·가정법 과거·분사·수 일치, 수면 설명문·교환 요청 이메일 읽기(주제·목적·일치)

passages.title: Sleep and Learning
passages.text:
Sleep is not just a time for rest.
While we sleep, our brain organizes the information we learned during the day.
That is why students who sleep well often remember more.
Unfortunately, many teenagers do not get enough sleep because of homework and smartphones.
Doctors recommend that teenagers sleep eight to ten hours a night.
If you want to study better, start by going to bed earlier.

passages.title: Wrong Size
passages.text:
Dear Manager,
I bought a pair of running shoes from your online store last week.
When the package arrived, I found that the shoes were the wrong size.
I ordered size 250, but I received size 270.
I would like to exchange them for the correct size.
Please let me know how to send them back.
Sincerely,
Minho Kim

items.explanation: recommend = 추천하다, 권하다 (거절하다 refuse, 기억하다 remember, 보고하다 report)
organize = 정리하다, 조직하다

items.stimulus: The shoes were the wrong size, so I asked for an ____.
items.explanation: 사이즈가 틀렸다 → 교환(exchange)을 요청했다.

items.stimulus: to bring or send something back to the place it came from
items.explanation: 원래 있던 곳으로 되돌려 보내다 = return(반품하다, 돌려주다) (deliver 배달하다, receive 받다)
unfortunately = 불행히도, 안타깝게도 (다행히 fortunately, 분명히 clearly, 놀랍게도 surprisingly)

items.prompt: 문맥상 단어의 쓰임이 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: He was exhausted after running a marathon.
The rumor turned out to be true.
She is reliable, so I often worry about her promises.
items.explanation: 믿을 만한(reliable) 사람인데 약속을 자주 걱정한다는 것은 어색하다. → so I trust her promises

items.stimulus: Regular exercise can ____ the risk of heart disease.
items.explanation: 규칙적인 운동은 심장병 위험을 줄일(reduce) 수 있다.

items.prompt: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것을 고르세요.
items.stimulus: She is likely to win the race.
choices: She wants to win the race.
She will probably win the race.
items.explanation: be likely to ~ = ~할 것 같다 → will probably(아마 ~할 것이다)
arrive는 목적어가 없는 자동사라 수동태로 쓰지 않는다 → The package arrived.

items.stimulus: Students ____ sleep well often remember more.
items.explanation: 선행사 Students(사람) + 주격 관계대명사 who

items.stimulus: I'm looking forward to ____ you again.
items.explanation: look forward to의 to는 전치사 → 뒤에 동명사 seeing

items.stimulus: If I ____ more time, I would help you.
items.explanation: 가정법 과거(현재 사실의 반대): If + 과거형, would + 동사원형 → had

items.stimulus: The book ____ on the desk is mine.
items.explanation: 책상 위에 '놓여 있는' 책 → 능동의 현재분사 lying이 뒤에서 명사를 꾸민다 (lie – lay – lain, 현재분사 lying)

choices: He has lived here since he was ten.
The number of students are increasing.
She let me use her phone.
items.explanation: The number of ~(~의 수)는 단수 취급 → The number of students is increasing.
의문사 + to부정사 = ~해야 할지 → what to do(무엇을 해야 할지)
자는 동안 뇌가 정보를 정리 → 잘 자는 학생이 더 많이 기억 → 공부를 잘하려면 일찍 자라.

items.prompt: 글에 따르면 잠자는 동안 뇌가 하는 일은 무엇인가요?
items.explanation: 'While we sleep, our brain organizes the information we learned during the day.'

items.prompt: 많은 십대가 잠이 부족한 까닭으로 글에 나온 것은 무엇인가요?
items.explanation: 'many teenagers do not get enough sleep because of homework and smartphones.'
'start by going to bed earlier.' 스마트폰을 끄라는 말은 직접 나오지 않는다.

items.prompt: 이메일을 쓴 목적으로 알맞은 것은 무엇인가요?
items.explanation: 'I would like to exchange them for the correct size.'

items.prompt: 이메일의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: 돈을 돌려받는 환불(refund)이 아니라 맞는 사이즈로 교환(exchange)을 원한다.

items.prompt: 우리말 뜻에 맞는 영어 단어를 쓰세요.
items.explanation: 추천하다 = recommend (c 하나, m 둘)

items.prompt: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰세요.
accept: I am interested in studying abroad
items.explanation: 전치사 in 뒤에는 동명사 → studying

items.prompt: 주어진 말을 바르게 배열하여 문장을 쓰세요.  (그는 내가 믿을 수 있는 사람이다.)
items.stimulus: ( I / he / a person / can trust / is / who )
items.answer: He is a person who I can trust.
items.explanation: 선행사 a person + 목적격 관계대명사 who(m) + 주어 I + 동사 can trust

items.prompt: 우리말에 맞게 영어 문장을 쓰세요.  <조건> If와 had를 사용할 것
items.stimulus: 내가 돈이 더 있다면, 그 컴퓨터를 살 텐데.
items.answer: If I had more money, I would buy the computer.
accept: If I had more money I would buy the computer
I would buy the computer if I had more money
If I had more money, I could buy the computer
If I had more money I could buy the computer
I could buy the computer if I had more money
If I had more money, I would buy that computer
If I had more money I would buy that computer
items.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대 → 가정법 과거: If + 주어 + had ~, 주어 + would + 동사원형
